title: Balance Test Timer
description: Single-leg stance stopwatch with age benchmarks for balance testing.
howto: Stand near support, lift one foot, and press Start.
Press Stop when you put your foot down or wobble off.
Compare your time against the age benchmark.
Your best time is saved in your browser.

faqs.q: How should I do the test?
faqs.a: Barefoot, eyes open, arms at your sides, near a wall or chair for safety. Time starts when the foot lifts.
Approximate typical single-leg stance times by age band. They are illustrative, not clinical cut-offs.
Stop immediately if you feel dizzy or unsteady. Safety first; this is not a medical test.
